description: Reads an ESP32 project from a public GitHub repo (or a folder or file in it, or a raw file link) or from files you pass inline, and returns: the board and chip, firmware type, the modules it uses, every GPIO it assigns with findings (flash pins, strapping pins, input-only pins, the board's own display/touch/SD pins, octal PSRAM pins), power notes, whether there is a custom PCB, BOM or enclosure files, whether the build fits Finish my build, and next steps. Free, read-only, stores nothing.

files.description: Project files inline instead of url: ESPHome YAML, platformio.ini, sketch (.ino/.cpp/.h), KiCad schematic, BOM CSV. Up to 12 files, 200 kB each.

url.description: https link to a public GitHub repo, a folder (…/tree/branch/path) or a file, or any raw file URL.

name: check_project
title: Check an ESP32 project
